Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

We're building the next chapter of AI-native craft and creativity - where craft and technology meet. Our unified platform bridges the gap between AI capabilities and human creativity, and lets professional creatives and designers harness the power of the world’s leading AI models without losing precision, expression, or soul.

Together, we’re building tools that help people move faster without sacrificing quality, precision, or craft - a platform where AI supports creativity instead of flattening it.

42416e60bc.t: Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 126 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .

Games are becoming an increasingly important way for people to connect, participate, create, and build daily habits online. On Reddit, games can be more than standalone experiences: they can be part of communities, fandoms, creator ecosystems, developer platforms, social loops, and new forms of participation.

The Games Ecosystem team is focused on helping Reddit become a better place to discover, play, discuss, create, and grow games and game-adjacent community experiences. This work can include player-facing experiences, fan communities, creator and developer tools, game discovery, social mechanics, community programs, platform capabilities, marketplace-style surfaces, and the systems that help high-quality games and experiences reach the right audiences.

Success means building an ecosystem where players find games they want to return to, communities become more participatory, and creators or developers can build compelling Reddit-native experiences with less friction.

We are looking for a Principal/Staff Product Manager to lead strategy for Reddit's Games Ecosystem. This person will help define how games become a durable part of Reddit's community and creator platform, while keeping the role broad enough to span both consumer/fandom experiences and developer/creator ecosystem work.

The right PM will be able to bridge multiple worlds: players and fans, communities and moderators, creators and developers, platform and product teams, and internal and external partners. They should be comfortable with consumer product strategy, community dynamics, creator ecosystems, technical platform tradeoffs, and ambiguous growth loops.

This is a high-leverage role for someone who can turn a broad opportunity into a focused roadmap, build alignment across many teams, and create the product systems that help games on Reddit become more useful, retentive, social, and scalable.

· Define the product strategy for Games Ecosystem, including how games fit into Reddit's communities, creator platform, and long-term growth strategy.

· Identify the highest-leverage opportunities across player experience, community participation, creator/developer enablement, game discovery, retention, and ecosystem quality.

· Build a roadmap that balances consumer-facing experiences, community-native features, creator/developer tools, platform capabilities, and ecosystem programs.

· Help communities become richer destinations for game-related participation, including discussion, identity, events, social play, creator content, and other repeatable engagement loops.

· Improve how high-quality games and game-adjacent experiences are discovered, distributed, and revisited across Reddit.

· Partner with Engineering, Design, Data, ML/ranking, DevRel, Community, Partnerships, Trust/Safety, Policy, and other teams to ship durable ecosystem improvements.

· Work with creators, developers, studios, moderators, and community builders to understand what makes games successful on Reddit and where the platform is creating friction.

· Define the right measurement framework for player value, community value, builder success, experience quality, retention, discovery, and ecosystem health.

· Create clear investment frameworks that help leadership decide when to build natively, support creators/developers, partner externally, improve platform primitives, or stop lower-impact work.

· Lead cross-functional teams through ambiguity and help them move from broad strategy to concrete shipped product.

· Experience leading ambiguous product strategy in games, communities, creator ecosystems, developer platforms, social products, marketplaces, entertainment, or consumer growth.

· Strong product sense for what makes games and game-adjacent experiences compelling, repeatable, social, and community-native.

· Ability to reason across multiple sides of an ecosystem: players, fans, communities, moderators, creators, developers, partners, and internal teams.

· Comfort with both consumer product questions and technical platform questions, even if your background is deeper in one than the other.

· Experience using qualitative and quantitative evidence to identify opportunities, prioritize investments, and measure whether a product loop is working.

· Strong cross-functional leadership across Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Community, DevRel, Partnerships, Policy, Trust/Safety, and senior leadership.

· Excellent written communication and decision frameworks that help teams align around ambiguous opportunities.

· Curiosity about games, fandoms, creator tools, AI-assisted creation, developer ecosystems, online communities, and the future of participatory entertainment.

About Checkr

Checkr is building the data platform to power safe and fair decisions. Over 140,000 companies and millions of people rely on Checkr for AI verification in the moments that matter most: getting a new job, a new place to live, a car ride, childcare, even a date. Customers include Uber, Pennymac, Airbnb, Doordash, Amazon, and Anthropic.

We’re a team that thrives on solving complex problems with innovative solutions that advance our mission. Checkr is recognized on Forbes Cloud 100 2025 List and is a Y Combinator 2024 Breakthrough Company .

Hiring decisions carry real consequences, for the safety of a workplace, the integrity of a workforce, and the trust employers place in the people they bring on. Employers today run verification checks across employment history, education, criminal records, driving records, and more, each with its own data sources, compliance requirements, and failure modes. As hiring volume grows, employers need verification products that are fast, accurate, and easy to trust, not a source of delay or risk.

As Senior Product Manager for Checkr's Verifications products, you will own the strategy and roadmap for a core part of the background check experience. You will improve accuracy and speed for employers while reducing friction for candidates, strengthening trust in the hiring process at every step. You will work closely with Engineering, Operations, and GTM teams to ship market-leading verification products, using data and direct customer input to guide every decision.

· Strategy & roadmap: Own strategy & roadmap for Drug & Occupational Health testing services, grounding decisions in customer discovery, GTM input, and data analysis.

· Voice of the customer: represent customer needs directly in product and technical design discussions, not just via research reports

· Competitive/market awareness: track competitor moves and market shifts that affect roadmap priorities

· Drive outcomes: Define and drive OKRs, connecting input metrics (attach rate, conversion rate, RPR) to output impact (revenue and profit).

· Implementation: Write clear specs and PRDs independently, and lead ops reviews that keep the team focused on the right metrics. Make implementation trade-off decisions, balancing speed, quality, and customer impact.

· Pricing & packaging ownership: partner with Finance/GTM to define pricing and packaging for your product area

· Launch leadership: own go-to-market coordination for releases — enablement, positioning input, and rollout sequencing

· Communicate roadmap, goals, and progress clearly to stakeholders and leadership.

· Model Checkr's values and build strong relationships within and beyond your immediate team.

· Bachelor's in Computer Science or related field preferred

· 5+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning strategy and roadmap for a product area with minimal oversight

· Deep fluency with data and analytics; comfortable defining and interpreting metrics like attach rate, conversion rate, and RPR

· Comfortable partnering closely with engineering on technical trade-offs, API/platform decisions, or system constraints

· Strong customer discovery instincts — you talk to customers directly and pair that insight with GTM and research input to build product hypotheses

· Proven ability to write crisp PRDs and specs without manager guidance

· Experience navigating ambiguity and driving cross-functional alignment across GTM, Ops, and Finance stakeholders

· An A-player mindset with a strong bias for action: you raise the bar, move with urgency, stay resilient through ambiguity, and take ownership to deliver meaningful outcomes.

If this role is remote, we have listed the top to the bottom of the possible range, but we will specify the target range for an exact location when you are selected for a recruiting discussion. 8df8eb57e2.t: The Sr Product Owner plays a critical role in ensuring that a product or feature is developed with a focus on delivering value to the customer and the business. They act as a voice for the customer and are responsible for making key product-related decisions throughout the development process, including identifying opportunities to incorporate emerging technologies, such as AI-enabled capabilities, where they can improve user experience, workflow efficiency, and business outcomes.

Product Vision & Stakeholder Alignment
Translation: Work with stakeholders to translate future vision and requirements into clearly broken-down epics and stories; ensure all team members understand and align with product goals, including consideration of emerging technologies where appropriate.
Stakeholder Communication: Act as the primary point of contact between the development team and stakeholders; communicate progress, changes, and updates regularly.
Team Enabler: Work with one or more Agile Development Teams and act as a central reference and information source, guiding system/product functionality decisions.
Entrepreneurial Spirit: Demonstrate a track record of delivering results in fast-moving, demanding environments.
Backlog Ownership & Prioritization
Prioritization: Create and maintain the product backlog; prioritize features, user stories, and tasks based on business value, customer needs, market trends, and strategic opportunities.
Backlog Management: Continuously groom and refine the backlog based on feedback, changing priorities, and new insights.
Feedback Integration: Gather and incorporate feedback from stakeholders and end-users into the backlog; adjust as necessary.

User Story Development: Break down high-level requirements into detailed, implementable user stories that meet strong Agile standards and support effective workflows, automation, and decision support where applicable.
Acceptance Criteria: Define clear acceptance criteria so the team understands what constitutes “done” for each feature.
UI/UX Alignment: Partner with UX to ensure backlog items have wireframes and UI designs ready for sprint planning; provide design feedback, participate in design sprints, and support user acceptance testing.
Planning, Delivery & Risk
Sprint Planning: Participate in sprint planning to select stories and tasks; ensure the team has a clear understanding of work scope.
Release Planning: Collaborate with the team and stakeholders to plan and prioritize releases aligned with market needs and business goals.
Quality Assurance: Ensure the product meets quality standards by accepting or rejecting work during sprint reviews.
Risk Management: Identify and mitigate delivery risks; partner with the release manager on timelines, tough conversations, mitigation strategies, and transparent escalation to leadership.
Business Outcomes & Data
Business Case Support: Assist in developing and presenting business cases for new features and initiatives; ensure alignment with strategic goals and stakeholder expectations.
Data-Driven: Define KPIs and measures for features and capabilities to track impact and inform decisions.

Bachelor’s Degree in relevant field
4-7 years of relevant work experience
Experience with Product and Development tools such as ADO, Jira or other similar tools.
Healthcare and technical expertise are highly preferred, including experience with data, API integrations, and interoperability standards such as HL7 and FHIR.
Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with the ability to use data and metrics to back up assumptions, evaluate outcomes, and assess opportunities related to emerging technologies, including AI-enabled capabilities, where applicable.
Leadership and decision-making skills
Excellent communication and presentation abilities
Understanding of the industry, market trends, and customer needs
Strong organizational and time management skills
Strong collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across Engineering, UI/UX, Product Management, leadership, and internal and external stakeholders.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the Product - Connect Platform

Connect is Stripe’s platform for businesses that serve other businesses. It gives platforms the infrastructure to represent the people and companies in their ecosystem, onboard and verify them, manage their accounts, accept payments, and pay them out - without building payments, compliance, or financial-services systems themselves.

This is how businesses like Shopify can help entrepreneurs run and grow their businesses. It is also the kind of infrastructure that marketplaces such as DoorDash need to coordinate money movement across large networks of restaurants, merchants, and dashers.

Connect has impact across industries. Shopify uses Stripe to embed financial services for merchants; Lugg streamlines worker onboarding and offers instant payouts; DoorLoop reduces manual customer onboarding tasks by nearly 50% with Stripe; and Sharetribe helps entrepreneurs launch and run marketplaces on Stripe.

AI is accelerating the emergence of entirely new business models: global networks of creators and experts, AI-native marketplaces, and agent-driven products that change how people discover, buy, sell, and deliver services. These businesses are more dynamic than traditional platforms: participants may operate across borders, take on different roles, and need new ways to establish trust, access financial capabilities, and get paid.

The Connect Abstractions team owns the platform primitives that make these models possible. We are building the foundational abstractions for representing participants, onboarding them safely, configuring their capabilities, and managing their lifecycle on Stripe. Our work will determine how quickly the next generation of platforms can launch, how flexibly they can evolve, and how much of Stripe they can bring to the businesses and people they serve.

Why this role

This is a chance to define a foundational product area at Stripe. You will turn a fast-changing set of user and product needs into durable platform primitives that work across products, industries, and geographies.

The role combines high-leverage strategy with hands-on product execution. You will work through ambiguous, consequential questions like: what should a platform be able to model? What should be simple by default but flexible when needed? How can Stripe make complex financial infrastructure feel effortless for a platform and its users?

The outcome of your work will compound. The abstractions you help create will be reused across Connect and Stripe, shaping what new products platforms can build and how quickly they can bring them to market.

We are looking for an entrepreneurial Product Manager to build the platform experiences behind Connect's next generation of users. You will own critical product primitives that platforms, including the fastest-growing AI companies, use to onboard, configure, and manage their users on Stripe. You will turn a clear strategic direction into products that solve hard user problems today while creating a coherent, extensible foundation for business models that are still being invented.

This role is for someone who enjoys the depth of platform work but is uncompromising about product craft and solving real user needs - both the ones users have today and will have in the future. The work is not building infra for its own sake; you will build capabilities that help our users launch a new marketplace, enable a global network to pay its contributors, or give a business entirely new ways for their end users to earn.

· Bring the next generation of Connect accounts to life. Own key product areas within the account platform, translating strategy into a focused roadmap, crisp product decisions, and high-quality launches.

· Build from use cases. Start with the real problems platforms face, such as onboarding a new seller, supporting a complex business model, or evolving a user's financial capabilities, and then work towards the primitives needed to solve them well.

· Make sophisticated infrastructure feel simple. Partner with engineering and design to create API and product experiences that are powerful and intuitive.

· See around corners. Develop a strong point of view on how AI will change platform economics, participant models, and financial workflows. Make focused foundational investments that unlock the next wave of demand.

· Turn user signals into durable product investments. Work closely with users, Sales, Partnerships, and other Stripe teams to distinguish bespoke requests from patterns that should become scalable platform capabilities, connecting business needs, user needs, and platform evolution.

· Drive high-velocity, high-craft execution and own outcomes. Lead cross-functional work from discovery through launch, and hold yourself accountable for developer experience, platform adoption, user value, and business impact, not simply features shipped.

This is not a downstream feature team. The SDK and Fluent are the foundation for Build Agent and what every off-instance coding agent, like Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, and whatever comes next, runs on when it builds a ServiceNow application in code.

The product you own is simultaneously a professional developer platform and the operating substrate for autonomous and human-in-the-loop AI agents, and the roadmap has to serve both without treating either as an afterthought.

You will drive the strategy and define what the SDK becomes next: not just a way to author metadata, but an operational surface an agent can use to safely discover, reason about, and change what already exists on an instance.
You will operate with a level of ambiguity and executive exposure consistent with Sr. Staff scope: co-owning governance conversations with cross-functional leaders, setting multi-year technical direction rather than executing a given one, and defining the vision for the agentic foundation in building applications on the ServiceNow platform.

Mit direkter Berichtslinie zur Bereichsleitung Kundenservice verantwortest Du die Lösung von der Konzeption bis in den Betrieb und schlägst die Brücke zwischen Fachbereich und IT. Das beinhaltet im Detail:
Du konzipierst die Lösung und treibst die Automatisierung im telefonischen Service voran.

Du führst Telefonie, CRM und Bots gemeinsam mit der IT zu einer Plattform zusammen und gestaltest ihr Zusammenspiel.
Du hast den Markt im Blick, entscheidest über den Einsatz neuer Technologien und verantwortest Qualität und Effizienz im Kundenkanal.

Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Owner / Produktmanager an der Schnittstelle von Business und IT, idealerweise im Bereich Voice oder Conversational AI.

Du kennst den telefonischen Kundenservice aus der Praxis und hast dort Verantwortung getragen.
Du arbeitest agil, User Stories sind für Dich selbstverständlich; Zertifizierungen wie Scrum, PRINCE2 oder PMP sind ein Plus.
​
Wir bieten
Eine Plattform, die Du gestaltest, nicht ein bestehendes System, das Du verwaltest.
Verantwortung im Aufbau, mit eigenem Team, eigenem Budget und direktem Draht zur Bereichsleitung Kundenservice.
Eine exponierte Rolle, die Service, Produkt und KI verbindet und Dich für die nächste Führungsaufgabe aufstellt.
Ein attraktives, der Verantwortung entsprechendes Vergütungspaket
​
Noch ein paar Worte zum Schluss
Der Prozess läuft komplett vertraulich. Vorab bekommst Du von uns einen ehrlichen Einblick in Unternehmen, Aufgabe und Rahmenbedingungen, und erst nach Deiner ausdrücklichen Freigabe gehen Unterlagen an unseren Kunden. We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles.

We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This is a rare chance to build a category-defining evaluation platform from the ground up, at a company where the outcome shapes how every business unit ships AI, not just one team's roadmap.
Why this role matters
Evaluation is the foundational differentiator for enterprise agentic AI. As frontier models commoditize, defensible advantage shifts to the orchestration and quality layer — how reliably an AI specialist performs in a customer's production environment. This role sits at exactly that inflection point:
You set direction in undefined space — there is no existing playbook to inherit, and the discipline you build becomes the standard others build on.
Your impact is horizontal and enterprise-wide by design, driven through influence, tooling, and a Center of Excellence rather than headcount.
You'll be the definitive point of reference for AI specialist quality across the portfolio — deep technical and methodological ownership without the dilution of people management.

Evaluation strategy and framework: Define the end-to-end evaluation methodology across ServiceNow's AI specialist portfolio — golden datasets, LLM-as-judge calibration, failure taxonomy, and a multi-layer metric model spanning agent behavior, user experience, and business impact.
Closed-loop evaluation platform: Move evaluation from a one-time release gate to a continuous improvement engine, where production telemetry feeds failure analysis, targeted evaluation expansion, and redeployment — making live signal, not synthetic testing, the primary driver of quality.
Cross-functional influence at scale: Partner with a federated Center of Excellence model — central methodology and tooling, embedded practice in each business unit — acting as the internal consulting function that helps teams stand up evaluation without rebuilding infrastructure from scratch.
Platform and tooling: Drive evaluation from bespoke effort to reusable, self-serve platform capability — evaluation infrastructure, data tooling, and calibration systems that make closed-loop evaluation available to every team building AI specialists.
What Success Looks Like
Your evaluation framework is adopted across multiple business units.
The closed-loop platform demonstrably drives specialist improvement release-over-release, sourced from real production signal.
Evaluation tooling is used self-serve by teams the Center of Excellence never directly staffed.
Your quality bar becomes the internally recognized authoritative standard for AI specialist readiness.

We are looking for an experienced, passionate, and hands-on Senior Product Manager to join our product team and grow the top of our marketplace funnel.
Aroundhome is a two-sided marketplace platform where the possibility of shared success begins with the match: the moment a homeowner is connected with the right partner. The House Owner & Service Request Acquisition domain owns everything upstream of that match.

It starts when a homeowner discovers Aroundhome through search or content, continues as they describe their home project, and ends when a qualified service request is handed to matching.

The quality of that request shapes the experience on both sides of the marketplace, so acquisition volume, conversion, and data quality are all part of your responsibility.
At Aroundhome, Product Managers play a pivotal role in shaping the success of Germany's leading housing project platform. We work in a domain-based model, where each product team owns a clearly defined part of the platform. This structure fosters close collaboration within cross-functional teams and ensures that the expertise for continuous product discovery, hypothesis development, and iterative improvement sits directly within each domain.
As a Senior Product Manager, you drive and execute the strategy, set a clear direction, and make sure your domain delivers meaningful value to both customer groups, homeowners and partners, as well as to the business.
You continuously shape domain strategy and vision, setting clear measurable goals and a roadmap for homeowner acquisition: steering the full acquisition mix across paid and unpaid channels with a clear focus on growing the organic share, improving conversion along the homeowner journey, and raising the quality of the service requests handed to matching. You actively rally those around you toward this vision.
You grow sustainable, unpaid acquisition through SEO, AI search optimization and scalable acquisition systems that compound over time, while keeping paid channels an effective and efficient part of the mix. You design and read high-traffic conversion experiments to lift conversion and data quality.
You are responsible for building a robust architecture and foundation that supports our acquisition experience. You ensure our setup is scalable and ready for automated qualification, enabling seamless processes that benefit the entire marketplace.
You identify where AI genuinely improves the homeowner experience and the platform's qualification processes, and you bring those opportunities into production together with Engineering, from first prompt experiments to shipped, measurable features.
You drive domain growth through continuous end-to-end product discovery, using qualitative insights (interviews, usability tests, feedback, NPS) and quantitative data to identify opportunities and make evidence-based, outcome-driven decisions with measurable impact.
You communicate with clarity and purpose, translate complex system and data topics into compelling narratives, and foster strong collaboration across Product, Tech, Product Analytics, UX, SEO and Content, Sales, and cross-domain stakeholders. You help carry the shift from a sales-driven organization toward a product platform.
You ensure a strong balance between long-term strategic goals and short-term trade-offs, driving continuous lean delivery through effective backlog management and close collaboration with Engineering and Design.
Skills
You have hands-on experience building organic acquisition and understand SEO fundamentals (topical authority, local SEO, structured data, page performance) as well as how AI-driven search and assistants are changing discovery (AEO), ideally within a marketplace or high-volume consumer platform.
You are experienced in optimizing complex user funnels and conversion flows, using experimentation (A/B testing) and data to improve conversion, quality, and user trust while laying the foundation for long-term platform engagement.
You apply strong analytical thinking and product analytics skills to define success measures, interpret data, uncover insights, and guide evidence-based decisions that improve homeowner and business outcomes.
You bring a strong technical affinity to help shape our underlying acquisition and conversion architecture. You understand the concepts of data models or taxonomies and have enough grasp of APIs and data flows to reason about feasibility and sequencing with engineers.
You work with LLMs as a natural part of your daily practice and can show concretely how they strengthen your discovery, analysis, and delivery. Ideally, you have taken AI beyond personal productivity and understand how scalable AI solutions reach production-grade features, for example through prompt chains, LLM-supported data extraction, or automated qualification flows.
You bring order into chaos by bringing together diverse perspectives, challenges, and priorities to establish shared understanding and strong alignment across teams, and you are comfortable chairing decisions no single team owns.
You think entrepreneurially and achieve your goals with a high degree of responsibility and ownership.
You follow the latest trends in product management and technology, are an absolute team player, and your excellent communication skills in English and German, along with a good sense of humor, characterize you.

Hybrid Work // Stay flexible: We embrace a hybrid working model that balances the autonomy of remote work with purposeful in-person collaboration. Ideally, you are based in Berlin or live within an easy commuting distance. While we offer flexibility, monthly presence in our office for team days, workshops, and meetings is required. Additionally, we offer you the possibility to work up to 30 days per year from selected EU countries.
Room to grow // Stay curious: In regular/annual feedback meetings, you design your own personal development path together with your team lead. In addition, we offer an annual training budget, free access to LinkedIn Learning, as well as great workshops to seek new input and specific training for your personal development.
Mental & physical health // Stay healthy & active: We care about your well-being and support your health with a discounted membership at Urban Sports Club. In addition, our cooperation partner "Fürstenberg Institute" is available to you and your family members with advice and support when it comes to mental health & coaching.
Taking responsibility // We #care: We care for our planet and the people who are living on it. To make our world a little bit better, our ESG Team (Environmental, Social & Governance) promotes our awareness of environmentally friendly behavior. In addition, we work with JobRad, offer a discounted BVG ticket, and actively support social projects in Berlin at our annual Social Day to give something back.
Teamspirit // Stay connected: What drives us is our sense of community. That's why we celebrate our Company Day once a month in our office at Potsdamer Platz, where everyone gets together in person. In addition to a comprehensive update of our C-Board, the main focus is on togetherness and the exchange of ideas over lunch and dinner together.

Natera's mission is to make personalized genetic testing part of the standard of care — enabling earlier, more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

For people who have faced cancer, that promise depends on continuity of care: our Signatera™ test is optimized for longitudinal monitoring, and its value grows each time a patient is tested over the course of their journey.

Ongoing, serial testing is what allows clinicians to catch a recurrence early, often before it would appear on standard imaging.
Natera's Oncology business unit is looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead the experiences that help patients and their care teams stay consistent with that monitoring over time.

You'll own how patients and providers stay engaged across the care journey, helping shape the digital experiences that make ongoing testing simple and intuitive for the clinicians who order it, the patients who rely on it, and the tools that help our clinical and commercial teams support them.

This is an individual-contributor PM role: you'll talk to users, dig into the data yourself, build prototypes, write proposals, define what success looks like, and drive initiatives from idea to launch.

You care about improving outcomes for patients and clinicians. You're comfortable navigating ambiguity, working across many teams, and making decisions with imperfect information. You're data-fluent – you'd rather pull the numbers yourself than wait for a report. You give and receive candid feedback, take ownership of hard problems, and don't wait to be told what to do. You think in systems, simplify what's overcomplicated, and get things across the finish line.

Drive product strategy and roadmap for keeping patients engaged in their recommended testing over time — growing the number of patients who continue monitoring, and making that effortless for the providers who order it
Simplify the ordering and scheduling experience so providers and patients always know what the next step is and when it's due, removing friction and manual work across the testing journey
Improve the provider and patient experiences that drive continued testing including our physician portal, EHR systems, and patient portal
Partner across commercial, operations, clinical, and engineering teams — including health-system and lab integrations — so our products reflect how care actually happens, and ground your decisions in data you regularly review
Own the product lifecycle from discovery to launch, define and measure success, champion your roadmap with senior and executive stakeholders, and advance the longer-term vision of clinically-informed testing recommendations that adapt to each patient's situation

4+ years of experience in digital product management; previous experience in healthcare, biotech, or life sciences is a plus
Demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional initiatives from idea to launch across product, engineering, design, and business teams
Strong product and UX judgment — skilled at identifying high-impact improvements, prioritizing ruthlessly, and balancing short- and long-term goals
Familiarity with AI tools (e.g., Claude Code/Cursor, LLMs, agents, prototyping tools) and a mindset for using technology to accelerate product development
Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
Flexible and agile; willingness to tackle any type of challenge; highly motivated to roll up sleeves and get work done while also thinking strategically

Experian Consumer Services helps millions of UK consumers understand and improve their financial lives. Credit scores, subscriptions, and marketplace products are the core of what we do today. New Growth exists to build what comes next: new revenue streams and propositions that turn ECS from a credit-score app into a broader financial wellbeing platform.
We're looking for a Product Manager – New Bets to be part of that mission. You will report to the Head of Product, New Growth, you will be shaping the strategy, running experiments, and shipping the roadmap. The work sits at the intersection of product, growth, and commercial impact. You will turn ambiguous ideas into live propositions, learn fast from real users, and help decide what we scale and what we stop.
If you want to work within a startup like team, and have founder-style ownership with the reach of a business that already has millions registered users, this is the kind of role that does not come up often.
What you'll be doing
Own the strategy and execution in the New Bets space
Take end-to-end ownership of New Growth's current New Bet: vision, roadmap, backlog, and outcomes. Evolve product strategy as you learn, and translate it into clear priorities quarter by quarter
When a bet matures or the portfolio shifts, transition it and pick up the next one with the same standard of ownership
Make trade-offs openly: what moves engagement, subscription value, or new revenue, and what does not
Run experiments that decide what we build
Design and deliver structured experiment programmes: GTM choices, product mechanics, habit and retention tests
Define hypotheses and success metrics with analytics; read results honestly and recommend what goes to BAU. Move quickly without cutting corners on customer experience or regulatory requirements
Ship customer experiences that people come back for
Own in-app journeys and the surrounding surfaces (email, CRM, subscription benefits) that make a proposition stick
Work with design to turn complex financial products into experiences that feel simple and worth returning to
Focus on relevance, habit, and recognition: the right value at the right moment, not a one-off feature launch
Work across ECS to make each bet land
Partner with marketing and CRM on launch plans, messaging, and in-app placement
Align with the wider ECS portfolio so new bets grow the business without undermining what already works. Build relationships across product, technology, compliance, and go-to-market so initiatives keep moving
Learn, document, and shape how New Bets works
Use data from experiments and BAU performance to shape what we build next. Contribute to how New Growth picks, sequences, and scales bets in the New Bets space
Experience as a Product Manager owning a customer-facing digital product through discovery, delivery, and iteration
Comfort with ambiguity: you can structure a fuzzy problem, test your way forward, and change course when the evidence says so
Strong analytical instincts: hypotheses, metrics, and experiment readouts are part of how you work
Clear communication with engineers, designers, commercial stakeholders, and senior leaders
Genuine curiosity about customers, markets, and what makes consumer products succeed
